sections.title: Findings
sections.narrative:
X-ray of the pelvis and right hip, 2026-11-09
Displaced medial femoral neck fracture on the right, Garden IV. No other fractures.
X-ray of the chest, 2026-11-09
Slightly enlarged cardiac silhouette. Emphysematous changes in both lungs. No infiltrates and no congestion.
X-ray of the right hip, post-operative, 2026-11-10
Cemented bipolar hemiarthroplasty in correct position. No sign of dislocation or periprosthetic fracture.

sections.title: Impression
sections.narrative: Displaced medial femoral neck fracture on the right, Garden IV, and no other fractures. After surgery, a cemented bipolar hemiarthroplasty in correct position, with no sign of dislocation or periprosthetic fracture. Chest: slightly enlarged cardiac silhouette and emphysematous changes in both lungs, with no infiltrates and no congestion.
